hero.description: The platform that connects clubs, players and the tennis community all across Chile.

profiles.title: Player profiles
profiles.description: Create your profile and find rivals at your level.
profiles.modalBody: Your profile brings your level, match history and stats together in one place. Other players see it to propose challenges at your level, and you use it to choose who to play.

ladders.title: Ladders and tournaments
ladders.description: Compete within your club or nationwide.
ladders.modalBody: Ladders let you compete inside your club, challenging players near your position to climb up. Tournaments are events with a fixed date and bracket, either within your club or open to the whole ChileTenis PRO community.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.description: Challenge matches and climb your ranking.
challenges.modalBody: From any player's profile you can send a direct challenge to play a match. Once the result is logged, it's automatically reflected in your ranking, no spreadsheets involved.

rankings.title: Automatic rankings
rankings.modalBody: Every match you play adds points to your ranking, both within your club and in the overall ChileTenis PRO ranking. The system calculates everything as soon as a result is logged, no manual updates needed.

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.description: Each club with its own identity.
clubs.modalBody: Each club has its own space within ChileTenis PRO, with its ladder, tournaments and player community. You can belong to more than one club and take part in all of them with the same profile.

challengeBanner.title: Find your next rival
challengeBanner.description: Play matches, climb your ranking and join the ChileTenis PRO community.

ranking.title: ChileTenis PRO Ranking
ranking.note: Adds up the real ladder points from each club.
ranking.empty: No players in the ranking yet.

clubCta.title: Have a club?
clubCta.description: Join ChileTenis PRO and digitize your ladder, tournaments, challenges and ranking in minutes.
clubCta.emailSubject: I want to add my club to ChileTenis PRO
clubCta.emailBody: Hi, I'd like more information about adding my club to ChileTenis PRO.
